name: Cairngorms National Park
story: Cairngorms National Park covers 4,528 square kilometres in northeast Scotland. Established in 2003, it is the largest national park in the United Kingdom. It features an arctic-alpine mountain environment with tundra-like characteristics, ancient woodland known as the Caledonian Forest, and the only herd of semi-domesticated reindeer in the British Isles.
matters: The park provides a unique alpine semi-tundra moorland habitat that is home to rare plants, birds, and animals, including breeding rock ptarmigan, Eurasian dotterel, snow bunting, golden eagle, ring ouzel, and red grouse.
